dek: Written by Dr Madhukar Shyam and Manya Singhal. This article argues that Taiwan's foreign policy towards the Indo-Pacific should be analysed within the framework of the New Southbound Policy and President Lai's NSP+. The FOIP strategy is perceived by Taiwan as an approach that will ensure its sovereignty. Beyond condem
